references.text: The people mourned when they heard the harsh words from the Lord, just as the Israelites mourned here after Moses' message of judgment.
The context for the words Moses spoke to the people - the Lord's judgment on the disobedient generation that would not enter the promised land.
Moses recounts the event when the Lord heard the people's complaints and swore that the wicked generation would not see the good land.
Israel mourned deeply after the defeat at Ai, a parallel to the people's deep sorrow here after hearing the Lord's judgment.
The people wept loudly when they heard the angel of the Lord speak about their disobedience, similar to the reaction to Moses' words of judgment.
Joshua spoke to all Israel, just as Moses spoke these words to all the children of Israel.
